'''Sondarr''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization [[Star's Nova]] operated a [[Sondarr Base|headquarters base]] in the [[Lunnes Wastes]] on Sondarr.
